paragraphs: The Freelander SD4 was introduced in 2011 as a higher-output diesel variant within the L359 generation, sitting above the eD4 and TD4. It uses the Ford Duratorq 2.2-litre four-cylinder diesel — a widely used unit across Ford and Land Rover models of that era. The SD4's higher output shares the same underlying Duratorq pattern as the lower-powered eD4, with the same known wear points: injector failure and DPF clogging are the most consistently reported issues.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace Ford Duratorq engines for every Freelander SD4 on the road.
